title: Announcing Cloudflare K2: serverless event streams
summary: Cloudflare K2 is a serverless event streaming service built directly on top of R2 object storage for high-scale data movement and long-term retention. By decoupling producers and consumers at the edge, K2 enables durable, ordered log streams without the operational overhead of traditional broker clusters.
author: Micah Wylde
title_norm: announcing cloudflare k2 serverless event streams
